text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said on Tuesday it has extended the expiration of the class A and class B redeemable warrants originally issued in conjunction with its initial public offering in 1992 and cut the exercise price of the warrants.
Unless previously redeemed, the warrants are exercisable until September 21, 1998.
The previous expriation date was September 21, 1997, the company said.

Also, the company adjusted its exercise price for its class A and class B warrants to $8.40 and $12.60, respectively. The company said it reduced the exercise price to reflect its public offering o 2.3 million shares in the first half of the year.

The holder of each class A warrant is entitled to receive one class B warrant and 1.071474 shares of common stock upon payment of the exercise price, and the holder of each Class B Warrant is entitled to receive 1.071474 shares of Common Stock upon payment of the exercise price, the company said.
